text: In May 2022, isotope tests by the Agroisolab laboratory and Hochschule Niederrhein, reported by German public broadcaster NDR, found cotton from Xinjiang in adidas garments, although adidas had said it would not use cotton from the region, where cotton carries a risk of forced labour.

source.name: Sourcing Journal (WWD): Xinjiang Cotton Detected in Adidas, Hugo Boss and Puma Garments
source.quote: Scientists say they have discovered traces of Xinjiang cotton in garments from Adidas, Hugo Boss and Puma despite the brands promising to no longer source materials or products

additionalSources.name: European Center for Constitutional and Human Rights (ECCHR): Adidas, Hugo Boss, Puma and Co.: Sourcing cotton produced with forced labor?
additionalSources.quote: In garments from Adidas, Hugo Boss, Puma, Jack Wolfskin and Tom Tailor, cotton was identified that, according to the available findings, originated from the Xinjiang region in western China.
